modules.name: ObjectGraph
modules.purpose: Canonical object graph: objects + relationships with provenance; the single source of truth every site compiles from.

modules.name: SiteSpec
modules.purpose: Declarative site specification: pages, sections, theme tokens; validated before render, never rendered invalid.

modules.name: component registry
modules.purpose: Named component catalog; strategies validate sectionPriority against it at module load.

modules.name: design tokens
modules.purpose: Theme token system: spec-level themeTokens plus the object-layer design compiler that turns intent into a shell.

modules.name: capability model
modules.purpose: What a viewer/agent may do: follow/like/ask/website runtime plus the grant vocabulary (FydGrant) and forbidden agent effects.

modules.name: renderer
modules.purpose: Spec -> React: renders FYDPage/FYDSection from the validated SiteSpec via the component registry.

modules.name: evidence model
modules.purpose: Provenance-bearing projections: every rendered claim carries evidence and a traceable basis; 'no customer fact without a traceable basis'.

modules.name: Ask FYD
modules.purpose: Evidence-bounded Q&A over the graph: answers from real evidence or explicit refusal; site-patch drafts are signed proposals, never mutations.

modules.name: proposal/approval path
modules.purpose: Owner intent -> review card -> approved directive layered OVER the compiled spec; facts and theme untouched; site patches stay drafts until approved.

modules.name: archetype/strategy inference
modules.purpose: Named composition strategies (KNOWLEDGE_WORKER/TRADES/TECHNOLOGY): explicit pin > deterministic graph inference > neutral default. Used by /build/[siteId]; NOT by /sites/* demos.

modules.name: media pipeline
modules.purpose: Discover -> rights-classify -> ingest -> derive -> manifest -> select: pipeline-ingested media with provenance, served as FYD derivatives (never hotlinks).

modules.name: claim binding
modules.purpose: Resource claim state machine: observed -> claimed -> verified-controlled, with verification seams and operator attestation.

modules.name: owner mode
modules.note: Demo-gated (NEXT_PUBLIC_FYD_DEMO_OWNER_MODE); no committed __tests__ in this dir.
modules.purpose: Owner capabilities behind a demo gate: capability evaluation, attestation preconditions, demo chain UI.

modules.name: customize
modules.purpose: Natural-language customization intent -> parsed -> resolved -> proposed review card -> applied overlay directive.

modules.name: acquisition
modules.note: Interface/policy layer only; no committed __tests__ in this dir.
modules.purpose: Policy-gated external acquisition (levels 0-3): the adapter interface for acquiring links/observations under policy.

modules.name: boundary/security
modules.purpose: Customer-owned vs FYD-owned data separation: package, export, import customer data; the legal/ownership seam.

modules.name: sitespec
modules.purpose: See SiteSpec module above (same directory). Includes graph binding verification, render-model, schemas, validator.

modules.name: fixtures
modules.purpose: Base graphs (TS), test projections (JSON {meta,graph}), media ingest + preview manifests, raw harvest snapshots, run notes.

status_legend: LIVE = implemented, tested, used in render path | PARTIAL = implemented but incomplete/gated/untested | STUB = interface only | TEST-ONLY = fixtures/tests only

supporting_modules.name: builder
supporting_modules.purpose: Verified-graph planning: verifyObjectGraph attestation, planSite with archetype vector, confidence/eligibility laws, private-leak guard.

supporting_modules.name: proceduralize
supporting_modules.purpose: Graph -> FYDSiteSpec data-driven generation; site_patch propose/apply; service extraction and structured data.

supporting_modules.name: tenant
supporting_modules.purpose: Tenant scoping: every lane operation runs inside a validated tenant context; cross-tenant reads impossible.

supporting_modules.name: social
supporting_modules.purpose: Social substrate reads (journal events, identity views, feed) and signed social envelopes.

supporting_modules.name: net
supporting_modules.purpose: Bounded network access: safe fetch with budgets and rate limits (media/safe-fetch.ts re-exports this).

supporting_modules.name: identity
supporting_modules.purpose: FYD identity: principals, sessions, provider seam, callback flow; demo-owner path.

supporting_modules.name: object (view layer)
supporting_modules.purpose: Object views: load/compose ObjectView and CircleProjection per slug, services derivation, owner commands, follow/like stores.

supporting_modules.name: ui/object-layer
supporting_modules.purpose: Object presence on the page: margin rails, placement, mobile sheet (debug-only explorer); product direction: no object bucket/drawer in primary UX.

supporting_modules.name: spatial
supporting_modules.purpose: Spatial object placement geometry; ui/spatial is a new untracked surface.

supporting_modules.name: preview
supporting_modules.purpose: Preview capture pipeline for site previews.

supporting_modules.name: refresh
supporting_modules.purpose: Source refresh: observe websites, diff snapshots, conflict handling; tested with node --test.

supporting_modules.name: adapters/activitypub
supporting_modules.purpose: ActivityPub follow/webfinger/signing adapter with committed jest config.

supporting_modules.name: rank/placement/attention/presence/onboarding/resolve
supporting_modules.purpose: Ranking, rail rules, attention control, presence derivation, anonymous-preview onboarding, entity resolution spike.

supporting_modules.name: harvest
supporting_modules.purpose: Harvest evidence docs (ATProto harvest notes, public social data fabric).
